item.title: Proposed House Bill would repeal parts of Colorado's 'Eugenics-era' forced sterilization law
item.description: Proposed House Bill would repeal parts of Colorado's 'Eugenics-era' forced sterilization law, addressing reproductive rights of a person with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

item.title: From Bone Blades to Olympic Gold: How Figure Skating’s Equipment Changed the Sport
item.description: Long dresses, flat blades, and modest lifts once defined figure skating. Historic artifacts in Colorado Springs show how toe picks, shorter skirts, and riskier jumps transformed the sport.

item.title: Damaging winds possible this week along with an increased fire risk
item.description: Powerful jetstream energy will mix down closer to the surface and bring strong, damaging winds to parts of southern Colorado. Meanwhile, the mountains will get over a foot of snow.
